name: Baron A. von Steiger
role: Homesteader and farming partner of A. T. Packard
bio: Baron A. von Steiger took a homestead on the old soldiers' garden near Little Missouri in early 1884 and farmed the Packard-Steiger butte farm with the Cow Boy's editor. In June 1884 he went to St. Paul to organize a stock cattle company and also worked a claim in McLean County. He tracked a stolen team of mules into Canada and recovered it in July 1884, and that fall he brought fine potatoes to the company store. In July 1885 a Washburn paper reported a warrant against him for assault and battery, sworn by Mrs. Baily Katz.
